releaseNotes:
- Direct Upload and FTP: Windows-style multi-select (Ctrl/Shift/Ctrl+A) plus bulk Delete and Download
- File selection highlight now fills the full row so multi-select is easier to see
- Dialogs no longer open off-screen when the app is minimized (looked hung after upload)
- Notification dialog fade-in plays once instead of flashing twice
